info.description: Operations wall for Zabbix: inventory health, availability, CPU/memory/disk/network utilisation, data freshness, top servers and active problems. The Data Center Operation Command Center dashboard adds eight fleet KPI panels, Production and Disaster Recovery environment breakdowns with health-mix donuts and tier hive grids, and the active problem table. Panels are driven directly by Zabbix host groups, host tags (environment, tier, business_service) and standard agent item keys. Linux, Windows, AIX, Solaris and IBM i/AS400 hosts are supported, including the AS/400 agent emulator aggregate CPU and disk-unit keys and SNMP HOST-RESOURCES fallbacks for CPU, memory and interfaces. Every KPI count, Business Services row and DR Readiness row is click-through to a filterable server inventory scoped to that row, and every host square opens a per-server drawer with gauges, 24-hour history, filesystem usage and that host's problems; clicking any utilisation panel opens full history charts for CPU, memory, disk, network and every filesystem, with 6-hour, 24-hour, 7-day, 30-day, 90-day and 6-month range filters. Includes a deterministic sample dataset, which can be enabled or disabled on the plugin's Zabbix connection tab; when disabled the dashboard is live-only and hides the SAMPLE switch. The live Zabbix server address, transport and authentication (API token or username/password) are also configured there, so the plugin can be installed on any Grafana server and point at a remote Zabbix. Read the Overview tab for the full panel-to-tag mapping.
